## ZAMBIA — profile (page 238)

- **Header facts:** Region: **Sub-Saharan Africa**; Income group: **Lower-middle-income**; Lending category: **IDA**; Data status: **Data as reported (A)**; Population: **21.9 million**; GNI: **26,313**; Unit line: **US$ million, unless otherwise indicated**.
- **Total external debt stock, 2025:** **28,633**, **+2.1% from 2024**.

- **Figure 1. Total external debt, 2015–25:**  
  Printed start and end values are **12,311** (2015) and **28,633** (2025). The line rises from 2015 to 2017, continues up to a peak around **2019–20** at **≈30,000**, dips in **2021** to **≈27,000–28,000**, recovers in **2022–23** to **≈29,000–30,000**, edges down in **2024** to **≈28,000–29,000**, and ticks up slightly in **2025**.

- **Figure 3. Debt ratios, 2015–25:**  
  Shaded band shows the **25th–75th percentile range of DRS reporting countries**.
  - **External debt / exports:** **190%**, **-12.8%**. Trend: rises from 2015, peaks around **2018–19**, then declines overall, with a small uptick before falling again by 2025.
  - **External debt / GNI:** **109%**, **-12.5%**. Trend: climbs to a peak around **2020**, then declines, with a mild rebound around **2023–24**, ending lower in 2025.
  - **Debt service / exports:** **19%**, **-36.4%**. Trend: volatile; rises sharply to a peak around **2018**, falls, spikes again around **2023**, then drops back by 2025.
  - **Debt service / GNI:** **11%**, **-36.1%**. Trend: volatile; gradual rise early on, higher around **2020–21**, declines, spikes again around **2024**, then falls in 2025.
